feature_request: "Create a Python password_validator.py that validates password length, uppercase, lowercase, digit and special-character requirements, and create comprehensive pytest tests."
acceptance_criteria: The module password_validator.py must provide a public function that accepts a password string and returns a boolean indicating whether it meets all validation rules.
The validation logic must enforce a minimum password length of at least 8 characters.
The validation logic must require the password to contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.

The companion pytest test file must include test cases for valid passwords that satisfy all rules and invalid passwords that violate each specific rule (length, missing uppercase, missing lowercase, missing digit, missing special character).
plan:
NEW FILE: password_validator.py - Implement the module with a public function that accepts a password string and returns a boolean. The logic must enforce a minimum length of 8 characters and require the presence of at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.

NEW FILE: test_password_validator.py - Create a pytest file incorporating comprehensive tests. Include test cases for valid passwords that meet all criteria. Include specific invalid test cases for each violation type: password too short, missing uppercase, missing lowercase, missing digit, and missing special character.
